# coeditHTML

> coeditHTML turns a single HTML file into a shareable link that other people
> can read, comment on, and edit in their browser, with no account and no
> install. It is built for the self-contained HTML files AI tools produce:
> decks, dashboards, reports, and one-pagers.

The file is stored byte for byte and is never rewritten. The editor is added
when the file is served, so comments and edits live alongside the file rather
than inside it. Uploaded files are served from a separate domain from the app,
so a file's own scripts cannot reach a page holding somebody's session.

Every upload produces three separate links: one to read, one to comment, and
one to edit the text. Each can be revoked on its own, and any link can be put
behind a password. Feedback comes back as plain markdown, or as one HTML file
with the edits applied.

Limits: one self-contained HTML file per upload, up to 5MB. Project folders,
JSX, and anything needing a build step are rejected at upload.

Price: free while the product is early. No billing, no card.

## Pages

- [Home](https://coedithtml.com/): what the product does, who it is for, and
  answers to the questions people ask first.
- [Tutorial](https://coedithtml.com/tutorial/): opens a private working copy of
  the app that walks through every feature. This is the explanation; there is
  no separate documentation page.
- [Report a file](https://coedithtml.com/report/): abuse and DMCA contacts.
- [Privacy](https://coedithtml.com/privacy/): what is collected and kept.
- [Terms](https://coedithtml.com/terms/): terms of service.

## Agent Resources

- [Auth & Registration Guide](https://coedithtml.com/auth.md): authentication flows and code samples for autonomous agents.
- [API Catalog (RFC 9727)](https://coedithtml.com/.well-known/api-catalog): machine-readable index of APIs.
- [A2A Agent Card](https://coedithtml.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent-to-Agent capabilities and skill definitions.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Spec](https://coedithtml.com/openapi.json): full REST API contract.

privacy@coedithtml.com for data requests.
